messages:
lee: Seeing a huge spike in request queue for text-gen euc1, autoscaler triggered but nodes not arriving.  P50 latency spiking > 2s and token backlog growing :fire:

maria: deploy-bot reports 18 scale-up events in last 3m for gpu-pool-euc1, but cloud provider shows provisioning stuck at 0/8 requested

deploy-bot: Autoscale: desired=8 -> observed_launch=0, reason=quota_or_provision_failure (API RATE_LIMITED)

lee: Logs show provisioner hitting 429s from cloud API and intermittent network timeouts to the control-plane in eu-central.  Sample: ```2026-03-18T14:02:11Z provisioner.go:420 initiateCreate -> 429 Too Many Requests```

rahul: Also seeing thrash: controller keeps resubmitting launches then cancels when probe says unhealthy -> delete -> retry loop.  Probably bad health check signal causing fast scale-downs + immediate scale-ups

autoscaler-bot: scale_event: pool=gpu-pool-euc1, up=+8, down_delay=30s, last_decision=14:01:51, decisions_in_window=9

xin: Cost note: if we failover to us-west and spin similar capacity, we cross into extra reserved billing tier for Q1 if we exceed steady commit.  Need approval if we keep it >2h

maria: Immediate mitigation: I'm going to set the pool to manual desired=6 and disable scale-down.  That should stop the delete/create thrash and give time for provisioning to catch up.  Applying now: `infractl pool set --name gpu-pool-euc1 --desired 6 --disable-scale-down true`

lee: Applied.  Confirmed desired=6 in control-plane but cloud still showing 0/6 pending for ~4m.  Network traces show control-plane -> cloud-api connections reset occasionally, maybe transient region networking issue

rahul: Start shifting traffic: will route 35% of new requests to us-west1 via traffic-manager weights to reduce pressure on euc1.  Command: `tmctl route set weights --service text-gen --region eu=65,us-west=35`

xin: Approved temporary failover for 2h, monitor cost dashboard.  Set a tag `incident:euc1-provisioning` so chargebacks are tracked

lee: After routing shift, observed queue in euc1 dropped 60% and latencies improving.  New problem: us-west showing colder cache misses, higher token cost per request.  We'll accept for availability

maria: For longer term, I suggest increasing autoscaler stabilization window and add a debounce on health-probe flips.  Current health check is pod_ready metric from our sidecar which had a stale memcache returning false positives.  Proposed change: require 2 consecutive healthy reports over 30s before allowing scale-down

rahul: Filed PR with suggested autoscaler config: `stabilizationWindowSeconds: 60, scaleDownUnhealthyDelay: 30s, minReplicas: 2` linking to logs.  Will also add circuit breaker to stop new scale-up actions if cloud API returns >10% 429s in last 1m

deploy-bot: PR opened: infra/autoscaler#412 - add stabilization window and cloud-api-429 circuit breaker

oncall: Creating incident: INC-2026-0874, summary: euc1 provisioning/thrash during sudden load spike -> partial failover to us-west.  Actions: postmortem, tagging, cost review, autoscaler config change.  Assigning to eng-infra/ops.

lee: Next steps: keep pool manual for 30m, watch provisioning.  If provisioning recovers, revert to autoscaled policy with new config.  If not, prep to warm a reserved pool in another region.  Thanks all for quick responses :thumbsup:
